name: Brewing Results: Bad Effects
description: Harmful brewing effects. Higher rolls are better: 1 is catastrophic, 30 is trivial. Tiers: 1 catastrophic, 2-6 major, 7-12 strong, 13-18 moderate, 19-24 minor, 25-30 trivial.

results.text: You suffer the effects of the harm spell: make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 14d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Your hit point maximum is reduced by the necrotic damage taken until you finish a long rest. This effect can't reduce your hit points or hit point maximum below 1.

results.text: For 8 hours, you can't regain hit points by any means.
results.description: For 8 hours, you can't regain hit points by any means.

results.text: Your flesh begins to harden. Make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you are restrained; at the end of your next turn, repeat the save. On a second failure, you are petrified for 1 hour (greater restoration ends it early).

results.text: You are paralyzed. At the end of each of your turns, make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on a success. The effect ends on its own after 1 minute.

results.text: You are cursed for 8 hours, or until the curse is removed by remove curse (as the bestow curse spell). Roll a d6 for an ability (1 Str, 2 Dex, 3 Con, 4 Int, 5 Wis, 6 Cha); you have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws with it.

results.text: You are slowed for 1 minute (as the slow spell): your speed is halved, you take -2 to AC and Dexterity saves, you can't take reactions, and you can take either an action or a bonus action on your turn, not both.

results.text: Make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you fall unconscious for 1 minute, or until you take damage or someone uses an action to wake you.
